method.semanticReview: Direct whole-object read; findings are tied to current prompt facts, unit lens, accepted decision, options, Reason, Details and feedback. n05Conclusion.summary: All nine N05 objectives require a specific mechanism trigger (construction variation; copy/identity choice; incompatible interface; added wrapping policy; uniform leaf/group operations; independent variation axes; intrinsic/extrinsic reuse; or dependency-graph assembly). The 153 visible cases instead describe one-operation business invariants and do not establish those triggers. This is a per-object review of the named lens and facts, not a source marker verdict or approval for a blanket rewrite. Apply identity policy individually after a proposed correction.

n06Progress.partialDispositionNote: N06 has been read item by item. CONTRACT_GAP marks explicit facts that make the broad mechanism plausible but do not isolate it from a simpler design; other objects are CONFIRMED case/objective or feedback defects. This is not whole-bank acceptance.

n07Progress.partialDispositionNote: N07 whole-object review is complete. CONTRACT_GAP records combinations of visible domain facts that plausibly touch a persistence mental unit but omit the persistence/query/transaction behavior that separates that design choice from a direct domain operation.

n08Progress.directReadReview: All 9 complete source arrays / 162 whole objects; prompt, constraints, each option/key, Reason, every Details field, each option-ID message, sourceRefs and exact hashes recorded.
n08Progress.systemicFinding: The concrete case facts cycle through general domain invariants while the unit lens is named in each stem. The unit-wide key is a single shared synchronization/ownership sentence; it is not individually selected by explicit competing-access, atomicity, lock-graph, async-cancellation, resource-lifetime, failure-point, or retry-boundary facts in most items. Four generic alternatives and almost-identical diagnostic/Details templates recur in all nine arrays.

exactPriorReviewMatches.priorFinding: The exercise depends on preserving one learner-visible result, but the stem provides no access pattern, query cost, or hidden-I/O consequence to choose lazy vs eager loading. The design lens is a label, not a case-specific decision.

Temperature restrictions and hand-off ownership are stated, but there is no concurrent nested acquisition or progress hazard to motivate lock ordering. The keyed deadlock lesson is unrelated to the explicit transfer facts.

Stable lesson identity must preserve learner progress, but no cancellation, timeout, or asynchronous-completion behavior is stated. The keyed async ownership principle is not supported by the retirement scenario.
The submission must be complete or retryable, but no resource acquisition/release lifecycle is specified. The RAII answer is not established by an offline submission outcome alone.

n08Progress.notes: N08-B02-i015 prior finding was not reused: its exact fingerprint refers to an invoice/idempotency question, whereas the prior report text describes lazy/eager query loading. This is recorded as a prior finding mismatch, not accepted as a current source fact.

n09Progress.directReadReview: All 9 complete source arrays / 162 whole objects; prompt, constraints, each option/key, Reason, every Details field, each option-ID message, sourceRefs and exact hashes recorded.
n09Progress.systemicFinding: The case facts state valid domain outcomes but normally omit the code/test/current-public-contract/workload/review context needed for the nine distinct maintainability objectives. The prompt then names the exact unit lens and adds generic design-review pressure. Four broad wrong options and unit-level Reason/Details/feedback templates recur in all nine arrays.

exactPriorReviewMatches.priorFinding: Privacy and consent before external disclosure are clear, but the case gives no unnecessary abstraction, second variability axis, or substitution boundary. The keyed YAGNI choice is a generic slogan rather than a decision forced by the referral facts.

n09Progress.notes: Clock expiry and deterministic-test-without-live-integration facts directly support the clock seam component of N09-B01-i001; this does not validate the option’s broader list of seams or its unit-template feedback.
